avis.titre: an inch for a mile product

Yes, a lil goes a long way, but this product leaves my skin super dry considering inhave oily skin. Keep in mind this product doesn't remove makeup, its just a cleanser not sure what its suppose to balance

I've been using the Origins Checks and Balances Gentle Foaming Face Wash, and it's been such a good match for my combination skin. What I love most is that it's plant-derived, so it feels clean and refreshing without being harsh. It contains glycerin, which keeps my skin soft and hydrated instead of that tight, dry feeling after washing. Even though it's super gentle, it does an amazing job at removing makeup and impurities effortlessly—my skin feels fresh, balanced, and actually clean. Since I'm someone who prefers double cleansing, I really appreciate that this face wash doesn't strip away my skin's natural moistureI received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I absolutely love this face wash. A little goes a long way. I love the feeling on my skin.

avis.titre: Works well on my middle-age, oily, acne-prone skin!
avis.texte: I'm 54 and have been battling excess oil and acne since I was in my teens. I've tried nearly every cleanser and facial care product under the sun over the years trying to find a holy grail product to give my clear, oil-free skin. While this product isn't a holy grail, it does come close. I received a free sample of this about a year ago, tried it, liked it, and promptly forgot about it because life is busy. When it came up during the Ulta 21 Days of Beauty at half price, I figured I'd give the full-size product a go. I do use DHC cleansing oil to remove makeup before cleansing with the Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash. The texture and color remind me of good old Noxema, (If you know, you know) but with nowhere near the strong scent. It has a faint, slightly spearmint scent that isn't overpowering at all. I do apply it with a facial exfoliating sponge (buff puff, for lack of a better term) because I do use rx retinoid on my skin to help with acne and oil, and I do get the occasional flakiness. The Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash lives up to the name. It only takes a pea sized amount, but it does foam up nicely. I lightly exfoliate while cleansing and the lather is very creamy to the touch and pleasant. It's definitely a mild to the skin cleanser with no stinging or burning. It rinses easily and you're left with no residue and very clean feeling skin, but not so clean that it's been stripped completely of natural oils. I love the way my skin feels after using this and

I've been using the face wash on and off since the 90's maybe. I love it. I always makes my face squeeky clean with out leaving it dried out. This is one of my Favorite washes and I always go back to it!

I have used this cleanser in my routine for over 15 years. It's the 2nd step in my double cleanse. I cannot say enough good things about it. It helped calm and balance my acne in my early 20s and doesn't dry my skin in my early 40s. One of the best!

I am 51 years old and have tried a LOT of different face washes, but none are as good as this one. The scent is light and fresh. The product foams nicely. More than anything though, it leaves my face feeling so clean without making my skin feel stripped or dry. This is a product I buy on repeat!
This is a really good experience as the cream turns to a gentle cleansing foam. Does not leave skin dry or tight. Enjoyable to use with fantastic results.

avis.titre: Dried skin, makes skin feel waxy
avis.texte: Really wanted to love this. This product definitely not what i was expecting. Dried skin out and left my skin feeling dull & waxy. Had to return.

Got this as a sample, and I'm not sure if it went bad or if it just didn't like my skin because it left a layer of residue on my skin that was immediately felt after thoroughly washing if off. I had to follow it up with an exfoliator to make sure all of the residue came off.
I love this! Have used it for years. Bought the travel sizes because they were BOGO and needed them to go on vacation.

I love it's foaming action, and the fact that it takes just a dab in the shower. When I use my Clairins face brush, it rinses clean of my foundation that I wear. I'm always shocked when I try the samples of other facial cleansers and find that my face brush when rinsed after use remains covered in foundation! How can those inferior cleansers even clean your face?!

This face wash is amazing! You only need to use a small amount. It smells and feels great. Doesn't irritate and leaves my skin clean and soft.

avis.titre: good face wash, mixed on Origins business
avis.texte: I really like the face wash but feel mixed on Origins. They offered a free rose quartz roller with a certain purchase amount and so I bought extra to get to that amount, and then Origins sent me a random small scrub brush instead, even though it said "rose quartz roller" on the packing slip. I inquired with their customer service about the roller not being included and they told me they'd send one right out...and I got another tiny scrub brush.
I dont feel clean. I have oily/normal combination skin. Maybe this is more for dry skin people.

avis.texte: My eyes have never burned with any of the previous face wash products ive used but this one makes my eyes sting so bad. I tried it twice because i figured maybe it was something else the first time . Also my skin feels so dry and weird after washing with it. very disappointed😫

I have been a loyal frothy face wash consumer for many years now. The product has been consistent and worked amazing on my skin. It always left my skin feeling fresh and clean without over-drying. In fact, I've promoted the face wash for years and have other in my circle using the product now. HOWEVER, although their new slogan describes it as "new look, same ingredients", I can tell you that is not the case. How do I know? I actually still have some of the old packaging face wash left and have the new packaging formula and they are clearly different. First, the feel of the cream wash seems more oily, second, the new formula does not have the menthol potency that the original package wash has, and lastly, the new formula doesn't foam up at all. It just blends into the skin as if it were a moisturizer. Very disappointing to see this happen. It was my favorite face wash and honestly, I'm not understanding the need to change ingredients to a product that has been your best seller for quite some time now. Unfortunately, I will have to go out to market to look for another face wash that works. Cutting cost can't come at the cost of the reputation of your best seller. Sad to see such an amazing product end its amazing tenure.

avis.titre: The Best Face Wash in the Business
avis.texte: My family and I have used origins for years. Has kept our skin so beautiful and clear. Check & Balance is the best of best.
I absolutely love this face wash. A little goes a long way. I love the feeling on my skin.

The answer is NO; it's terrible. Anywhere where I shave my face broke out in razor burn rash. If you have sensitive skin, prone to rosacea, prone to skin inflammation -- I would recommend another brand. It smells great, and it does do a great job cleaning. But I'm pretty sure the skin barrier that I have spent good money on protecting with moisturizers was worn down by the harshness of this product.

I read a lot of reviews before purchasing the Origins Checks and Balances cleanser. First and foremost a little goes a long way with this product, you honestly only need a small amount to wash your entire face and neck well. The tube lasts a long time if used correctly. This cleanser froths up into a wonderful face wash that thorough cleanses so well. If you discover a few blemishes after using it, it's very possibly the product efficiently cleansing and shedding the dead skin cells and gunk from your pores. I was impressed how quickly my skin cleared up. I love and wear makeup, however at the end of the day I need my skin well cleansed. I'm really glad I gave Origins Checks and Balances a try! This is not a sponsored review.

I love this face wash 1. Easier to rinse off than most other face washes at the sink 2. A tiny amount (somewhere between the size of a pencil top eraser and a toothpaste serving) will lather up generously and wash your entire face. 3. It removes all makeup (I don't have to go back around the outer part of my face or double wash) 4. If you are unsure of you skin type (oily - dry)-this should work for you. I am 57 and think I have combo? 5. Because you need so little, its a good value (especially if you buy on sale)

avis.titre: The only face wash I like.
avis.texte: This product cleans without making my skin feel tight and dry. It does foam nicely when used and smells slightly minty fresh to me. I usually use and prefer facial scrubs, but there are times I want something gentler. This is the best face wash I have tried.

This is my first time using this product and I love it already. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate at all. A little goes a long way. You only need a drop, as per the directions, and it goes a really long way. It looks and smells great.

I have finished my third checks and balances, and this was my first time to place an order via online website. Loved the new design, quick delivery process (came to our place in 3 days I believe), easy to open the package not using the tapes, and customer service handling issues very well. Since changing my cleanser, I can better control my pores and overall skin condition. Definitely will use this again and again.

No other face wash product lathers up like this one! A small amount goes a long way and lasts. Your skin will not feel dry afterwards either. Been using this for years but miss the old packaging because I could see when the wash was getting low.

avis.titre: I HAVE bought this product over and over again!
avis.texte: It doesn't take much, so be careful when you squeeze the tube. But it cleans well and your skin feels so smooth and soft after a cleanse. I alternate this product with another of your products.
Really great keep buying it over and over. Not drying cleans gently really nice consistency.

avis.texte: Smells great and gives that squeaky clean feeling on the skin! However because of the essential oils in the formulation it dried out my dry zones on my combination skin. Might continue to use this product, targeting my areas that are more oily (cheeks/nose) and avoid my drier areas (chin and forehead) but don't know if I want to expend the effort of using two different washes. Won't be repurchasing because I need something for my whole face not because it was a bad product.

avis.titre: So Far I am loving IT!
avis.texte: I usually do not write reviews. I have extremely sensitive skin and have tried a lot of drug store face washes as well as high end face washes and so far I am on day 4 and am loving this face wash. The tiniest amount goes the longest way (seriously). The cleanser foams up and rinses off well leaving no residue. It does not sting my under eyes or anywhere more sensitive. Highly recommend trying this product if you are in the market for a new face wash.

I do like this product! But I am so tired of companies changing their packaging and design ALL the time. Just leave things alone for once. I liked the old design. This was one of my yearly Ulta Gifts which was nice. Pros: You only need a small amount. Just a dime sized amount lathers well. Luxurious feel. Rinses clean. Not drying. Con: Just do not like the ugly new bottle and brown color of the plastic. Looks cheap now!

I love the frothy pearly whipped texture. I love the herbal tea scent. I love how clean I feel afterward. I love the squeeze tube. I have loved this for decades. Two warnings. Well three. This will not be good for dry or sensitive skin. And never get it in your eyes.
Love love love this cleanser. I am weirdly annoyed by the packaging change. I hate the new one.
I have used this product for many years. I have occasionally tried others, but, keep coming back to Checks and Balances. I've never had any issues with it.

avis.titre: Say what they will but this formulation has changed
avis.texte: I have been using Origins products for decades. I am a male. This was one of the first Origins products I began using in their product line, so I am VERY attuned and knowledgeable as to the scent, texture and results of this cleanser. After contacting Origins several times about these changes, they were dismissive, not concerned and gaslit me about the changes. Most of the changes began after they introduced the Checks & Balances™ Polishing Face Scrub. Now, the Checks and Balances cleanser no longer had the clean and refreshing scent it once did. The texture of the cleanser has also changed dramatically as apparently they use the same production line for both the cleanser and the polishing scrub. The result of this is now that the Checks and Balances cleanser, still contains the polishing granules that should ONLY be in the Polishing Face Scrub.... NOT the cleanser. The texture of this cleanser has also changed. Now it is more of a greasy cream texture compared to the light more foamy texture it once had. This as well began after their introduction of the Polishing Scrub. So while they could have 2 products with different purposes and formulations, they changed the formula of the trusted and extremely highly rated original Checks and Balances to align with what they needed for the Polishing Scrub. This is a cheap cost saving measure, not a quality measure. Yet again another company whose main concern is cost cutting and not quality.
This foamy fresh cleanser is by far my new favorite cleanser. I love how it leaves my skin feeling so clean and revitalized but not dried out. I use it morning and night

It's alright for use in a hand cream formulation, but not one's face. This product has caused severe dryness, flushing and a rash that simply doesn't go away until the product is thrown away. avis.texte: I have generally oily/combo skin and hormonal acne that's usually not bad. I used this product for about 9 months and I feel that it absolutely disrupted my skin...stripped and dried it out to the point that once I stopped using it my face was completely overcompensating producing more oil that I felt like my face was constantly wet - not enjoyable. I experienced some of the worst acne I've had in over a decade while using this as well. Have heard that this brand is fine for the body but not the face and I can see why. Do not recommend.

I tried this product for 3 weeks day and night. I really wanted this to work as I had read really good reviews however it did not work for me. Everytime I would wash it off it would leave an odd residue that felt like wax on my skin it also caused me to break out so bad.
I love this cleanser! You dont have tonuse a lot, it lathers nicy and leaves my face feeling so clean. I notice that my skin looks so much healthier since using this.

avis.titre: Cleans everything I want to wash
avis.texte: I got it initially for my face but every part of my body loves this product. Plus I use it my boar bristle brush to wash my back. I love the lather and the squeaky clean feeling I get.

I've been using this product for a little over a month now & love it for my combination skin. I've noticed my skin is smoother & the pores on my nose & chin are smaller or non-existent. I love that a little goes a long way due to the lather. The only thing I can say negative about this product, is the spearmint oil smell. Maybe it's because I work in the dental field & smell mint all day lol
I like this cleanser a lot. A little goes a long way and foams up nicely. Leaves my skin feeling soft and clean. I am going to try the plantations cleanser next.

I chose this item for my diamond member free gift and am disappointed in my choice. The mint in this face wash made my eyes burn. It also is so stripping for my dry skin. After the first use, my skin was so dry i couldnt even glide my fingers across my skin. Would not recommend for dry, sensitive akin!!
A little goes a long way and it's not too harsh, yet it's able to get greasy sunblock off and smells so nice! I love it, a repeat buy.
LOVE this foamy cleanser BUT it is NOT cruelty free. I received this free sample at Ulta and im so sad I cant buy as I refuse to buy products tested on animals.

avis.titre: Cleared bad acne outbreak in days
avis.texte: I suddenly had the worst acne outbreak of my life and none of my regular skincare products worked to clear it. I've always had oily skin and now my skin is even oilier. I tried acne patches, gentle cleansers, acne cleansers, toners, you name it. Everything seemed to make my acne worse! Even my luxury brand 5% benzoyl peroxide acne lotion that has worked for 15 years didn't work in this case. I'm in my early 40s and can only imagine it's caused by hormonal changes from perimenopause. Literally, my face had angry red spots all over and I found new acne and clogged pores daily! I also pick at my skin which doesn't help. So, I cut out all of my products except for the acne lotion but I had to find a good cleanser. Out of desperation, I tried this cleanser. Within DAYS, my acne was clearing up and healing!! It did make my skin feel a bit tight, but it is keeping the oil and acne under control! I was surprised at how well this worked because I remember using it in my 20s and it gave me clogged pores. I guess it depends on your age and how your skin changes overtime. Maybe Origins changed the ingredients since then and improved the formula. I don't know, but it has saved my skin!!!

avis.titre: Best face wash I have ever had
avis.texte: Suffer from combination skin, rosacea, acne, and now aging. This has helped clear my skin better than any other product I have tried in 30 years. Wish I had found it sooner. I use the mega bright moisturizer with it and an occasional face mask like original skin and my face is healtheir now than when I was in my 20's.
Using this one everyday for the past 4 year and since them didn't thing to switch for something else

I used this product for a couple weeks and it was great! Loved the smell and it made my skin feel good. I used the product again 2 days ago and started to have a reaction around my T zone, I've never had that happen before. I was only using this product so I know it was a result of the face wash. I woke up the next morning and had to run to the drug store to get allergy medicine because my whole face was so swollen. It's been a day and my whole face is now bumpy and feels like leather. I wanted to love this product but after that I will not be using again.
Always my go to. This stuff is wonderful. It makes my face feel so clean without drying my skin out.

avis.titre: It's the only facial cleanser I use
avis.texte: Been using this product for a very long time. I love the way it feels and cleans without irritating my sensitive skin.

I'm super picky when it comes to my cleansers. I have sensitive skin and as of lately I've been really dry. I love a cleanser that is going to deep cleanse my face, but unfortunately a lot of the time most cleansers strip your skin dry to the point where it feels tight and irritated. THIS DOES NOT DO THAT! A little goes a long way with this product. Literally slightly more than a pea size amount and it'll be enough. In saying that, this product has an amazing lather and foams up beautifully. I feel a slight sensation from the cleanser, but even though I have sensitive skin it isn't enough to irritate it. If you're in the market for a new cleanser: THIS IS THE ONE. From a picky consumer to another picky consumer, this product will definitely not disappoint. I know of I still had oily skin I'd still love it.

This is the best facewash my skin has ever used. If you have dry skin especially during winter like me, just be careful and make sure you moisturize because it can dry your skin out some. But i love the clean feeling i get after rinsing it off. My face feels so fresh and new!
The cleanser has a very nice scent. You only need a drop. It foams up fast. Your face feels very clean.

All time favorite cleanser. I dont wear much makeup, but I use a tinted spf & mascara and this cleanser does a fantastic job cleaning my skin without leaving residue. It has a cooling sensation that doesnt cause irritation on my sensitive/dry skin. I only use this product at night (I skip morning face cleansing). The frothiness is insane, you only need a little for your face & neck/chest. Definitely recommend!

I have super sensitive skin as well as combination dry/oily skin and this stuff is AMAZING! first, it smells soo good it's like mint/tea tree and it makes your skin tingle putting it on. It leaves my skin feeling slightly dry, but not in a bad way, and super smooth. I love this cleaner so much I've reordered it twice already.

My husband and I use this face cleanser and it's the best we've found in a while. I always order the large one and have one in the shower and one near the sink. We workout daily and it does a great job of cleaning everything off with a gentle cleanse. A little goes a long way and it lasts a while. It foams up a lot so a tiny amount is fine. It leaves me clean, refreshed, and soft. One thing is it might leave you a little dry if using often, bc of that I sometimes switch cleansers for the evening or just put on some extra moisture.

This is literally the only wash that clears my acne. I have bought over 20 different face cleansers and only this one fully clears my acne. If you have normal skin with no ance this will dry your skin. But it's perfect for ance.

I love this checks and balances creamy cleanser! It is perfect for my dry skin and it has an addictive, minty smell. I actually look forward to washing my face with this in the morning and night because it feels luxurious.
I have combo oily skin and face cleaning products usually are either too moisturizing that I get oily super fast or too drying. I really found the perfect balance with this.
